test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Why do we have to do the house chores during this lockdown period?

options.text: The house chores are to be done during this lockdown period by us.
Why are the house chores being done during this lockdown period by us?
Why do the house chores have to be done by us during this lockdown period?
Why will the house chores have to be done by us during this lockdown period?

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Why do the house chores have to be done by us during this lockdown period?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is interrogative and in **Present Perfect Tense,**** Active Voice**.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Perfect Tense, Active Voice from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: Why + do + Subject + have + to + V1 + Object​ (Active Voice)__ 
 
 

 Why + do + Object + have to be + V3 + by Subject​ __(Passive Voice)__

__
 
• Example: *Why do we have to do the tasks?** *(Active Voice)

 * * *Why do the tasks have to be done by us? *(Passive Voice)​

 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Why do the house chores have to be done by us during this lockdown period?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)*​*
 
• *A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Present Perfect Tense, Active Voice में है।
 
• Present Perfect Tense, Active Voice को Active voice से Passive voice में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का object, Passive Voice का subject बन जाती है।
 
• Structure: Why + do + Subject + have + to + V1 + Object​ (Active Voice)__ 
 
 

** Why + do + Object + have to be + V3 + by Subject​ (Passive Voice)​**
